title: Reefer Cargo Services: Special Service and Remote Monitoring Charges
content:
Beyond inspection and terminal power, a Reefer Cargo Services unit can attract one-off charges for the tier's special service and for remote monitoring during the voyage. This page states when each is due, how it is measured, and the limits on booking such one-off charges.

## Clause

A tier that includes a special service of its own, whether cold treatment, controlled atmosphere, GDP handling or superfreezing, charges it once, at departure, at the tier's flat special service fee and under that tier's own charge code. A tier whose special service code reads none has no special service and raises no such charge. On tiers whose units are remotely monitored by the line, remote monitoring is charged once, at delivery, as the tier's daily monitoring fee multiplied by the number of calendar days from the departure date to the delivery date. The late request fee and the fee for cancelling after inspection belong to this same family of one-off charges, though their grounds and amounts come from the order lead-time rule and the cancellation rule rather than from this page.

For any charge of this family to be entered, the service must stand at one of four statuses: requested, in transit, delivered or cancelled. Within this family, each charge code is used no more than once on any one service, and whether a code of the family has already been used is judged from the service's charge records.

## When each charge falls due

| Charge | Moment it falls due | Service status at that moment | Measure |
|---|---|---|---|
| Special service of the tier | departure of the vessel | in transit | the tier's flat special service fee |
| Remote monitoring | delivery of the laden reefer | delivered | daily monitoring fee multiplied by the calendar days from departure to delivery |

## Points of judgement

- **A tier without a special service code.** Nothing is booked at departure under this heading.
- **A tier without remote monitoring.** Nothing is booked at delivery under this heading.
- **A second departure charge.** If a charge already stands under the special service code of that service, a further one under the same code is not booked.
- **A service standing at inspection passed or plugged in.** Neither status is among those in which a one-off charge of this family may be booked.
